purpose: Create a source-only V9 daily-down reflection group that reads as a compact, calm down gaze rather than a startled pair of lower white discs.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the sole generator reference. V36 attempts 01 and 02 are retained comparison/rejection evidence and are not generator inputs.

output_contract.format: one unlabelled 200x200-equivalent V9 daily-down source face; no grid, text, border or alternate state
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on a plain white background; no grey, color, texture or shading
output_contract.allowed_change: only the large white highlight and smaller companion sparkle inside each existing open black eye silhouette

daily_down_geometry.primary_highlight: modest vertically soft lower-inner reflection, smaller than the dominant V9 upper highlight and never a large circular white disc
daily_down_geometry.companion_sparkle: clearly subordinate, nearby and toward the nose side of the primary, forming one compact reflection group
daily_down_geometry.rim: continuous black rim remains visibly generous above and below the group, with no white component contacting any eye edge
daily_down_geometry.relationship: left and right eye groups are balanced and calm, reading as a gaze lowered toward the lower centre rather than surprise, cross-eyes or an unfocused stare

protected_identity: V9 outer black eye silhouette, placement and scale

forbidden: replace or edit the locked V9 source file
large lower circular white discs or detached diagonal sparkles
new outer eye silhouette, eye size or eye placement
new face, brow, mouth, cheek or charm art
full-face runtime frame, full-face animation loop or full-face state card
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, candidate activation, provisioning or firmware flash
required_machine_gates_before_use: generated source SHA256 and lineage record
outer-eye silhouette/identity comparison against locked V9
native-200 daily-down readability and reflection-group coherence evidence
